name: weather-time
comment: No chunks, no player: World.tick's time and weather alone. The first tick's updateWeather draws both timers (thunderTime and rainTime are 0 in a new WorldInfo); set_time puts the clock just before a day boundary (23990), back to 0, and before dusk (11950), where calculateSkylightSubtracted changes. world_time and rng_state every 10 ticks pin the clock (autosave cadence, world time + 1 per tick) and that nothing else draws from World.rand.
